    NAME
           fgets - input of strings
    
    LIBRARY
           Standard C library
    
    SYNOPSIS
           #include <stdio.h>
    
           char *fgets(char s[.n], int n, FILE *f)
    
    DESCRIPTION
           fgets() reads in less than
           `size` characters from `f` and stores them
           into the buffer pointed to by `s`.
           Stops after an EOF or a newline.
           A terminating null byte ('\0') is stored
           after the last character in the buffer.
           
    RETURN VALUE
           fgets() returns `s` on success, and NULL on
           error or when end of file occurs while no
           characters have been read.
